meta.notes: The configured feature says what a tree looks like: a birch trunk five to seven blocks high under a round crown of acacia leaves. minecraft:soil_beneath_tree is vanilla's rule-based soil provider: the block under the trunk becomes dirt, as under vanilla trees, unless it is in #minecraft:cannot_replace_below_tree_trunk. The placed feature msm_examples:amber_tree_placed says where and how often it grows. Element ids are unique in a project, so the placed feature has its own name.
